comment: Shared by src/shared/ios-sync-contract.test.ts (a reference reader written in the test, until src/main/sync/ exists) and by ios/LuciumKit (SyncVectorTests). The frames and messages of docs/synchronisation.md §7, the marks of §9.2, the canonical form of §8.4, the classes of the fields and the closed list of settings of §10, and what a received entity may carry. A message may be given as `message` (an object) or as `raw` (the text, for what an object cannot hold, such as a __proto__ key); `fill` makes a long value without filling the file: with `repeat` it replaces the text at `path` by `repeat` written `times` times, with `copy` it replaces the list at `path` by `times` copies of `copy`. Written by a script from fixed inputs: change a rule on one side and the other side fails.
